description: Build a hands-light stage navigator (the QLab model) for stepping through an ordered scene/cue list: Next / Prev to move the pointer, Go to fire the current scene's cue on the target COMP, and an Index knob to jump directly. Optionally quantizes GO to the next beat. The navigator drives `manage_cue` recall on the target so cue morphs and beat-quantized changes all work. Use after building a control panel with `manage_cue` cues stored; then perform the show by hitting Next + Go instead of recalling by name.

go_on_beat.description: Quantize GO to the next beat (needs a tempo/beat source).

name.description: Name of the navigator COMP to create.

parent_path.description: Parent COMP path the navigator container is created inside.

scenes.description: Ordered cue names to navigate. Omit or leave empty to read the target's existing cues.

target.description: The COMP whose cues this navigator steps through. Cues are recalled on it via manage_cue.

name: create_set_navigator
title: Create set navigator
